name: How do professionals match existing stucco texture and color?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals match existing stucco texture and color?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals match existing stucco texture by analyzing the original finish (e.g., smooth, Santa Barbara, lace, dash) and applying new material in a way that replicates it. Color matching often involves using tinting agents or paints specifically designed for stucco, sometimes requiring a full coat over the repaired area and surrounding stucco to ensure uniformity, especially if the existing stucco has faded over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals match stucco texture by replicating the original finish and use tinting or painting for color, often blending with surrounding areas.
